title: Open Jam @ Tavern off the Green
event_description: A laid-back walk-in jam at Morristown's self-described unfussy neighborhood bar. Local musicians sit in for a few songs together every other Wednesday alongside the bar's regular live-band weekends.
event_time_plain: 8:00 PM - 9:30 PM (confirm exact time via venue social media)
event_venue_information:
Tavern off the Green

Morristown's self-described "unfussy local watering hole" on Morris Street, with pool, darts, sports on TV and a regular local crowd.

Live Music and the Open Jam

An Open Jam runs every other Wednesday night, generally starting between 8:00 PM and 9:30 PM — check the venue's Instagram or Facebook for the exact time on a given date. The bar also books local and regional bands most weekends.

title: Open Jam @ Laundromat Speakeasy

event_venue_information:
Laundromat Speakeasy

A basement, 23-and-over cocktail bar in downtown Morristown with a speakeasy feel and a curated live entertainment calendar.

Live Music and the Wednesday Jam

The venue's published schedule lists a Jam Session Wednesdays from 7:00 PM to close, with a fuller live-band lineup Thursday through Saturday. Hours have varied on the venue's own site, so confirm the current schedule before visiting.

title: The Folk Project Open Stage @ Morristown Unitarian Universalist Fellowship
event_description: A monthly acoustic open stage in a proper listening room. Up to 15 performers get two-song sets chosen in advance by email, with optional backing from the house band, in a smoke-free alcohol-free setting.
backline: PA system and house band accompaniment (Bunk Bed Band) available
event_venue_information:
The Folk Project Open Stage

A smoke-free, alcohol-free listening-room concert series hosted monthly at the Morristown Unitarian Universalist Fellowship.

The Open Stage

Held the second Friday of each month at 7:30 PM, $7 admission. Up to 15 performers get two-song sets chosen in advance by email, with optional backing from the house Bunk Bed Band.
